independence.scope: Independent source-body equality, literal query-premise binding and counting; exact mathematics and producer trace auditing are not repeated.

interpretation.new_126: Newly inspected matrix-retained unsupported pairs in 120 previously unscanned scenarios. Both endpoints have SAT support and all pairs are conditionally refuted. These are not failed actual commitments or undetected conditional gaps.
interpretation.first_round: The saved first diamond round is read directly; no counterfactual old-policy rerun is claimed.
interpretation.nodes: New-search nodes measure this scan search telemetry. Reused nodes describe archived searches and are not current search work.
interpretation.counts: Unique query records within each scene, not globally unique queries or independent graph samples.
interpretation.histories: Prefix references from one history are correlated and kept distinct from graph keys.
